episodes.title: Last Episode of The Belief Trap! The Altamira Boys - Brazil's Cult of Child K*llers
episodes.description:
Between 1989 and 1993, the Brazilian town of Altamira was gripped by fear as young boys began disappearing. Some were later found murdered and mutilated, while others vanished without a trace. The investigation eventually led authorities to members of the Superior Universal Alignment (Lineamento Universal Superior), a fringe spiritual movement founded by Valentina de Andrade, whose teachings claimed that children born after 1981 were spiritually corrupt and beyond redemption.






In this episode, we examine the horrifying Altamira child murders, the cult's disturbing ideology, the respected professionals accused of participating in the crimes, and the decades-long legal battle that followed. We also explore the controversy surrounding the investigation, Valentina de Andrade's acquittal due to insufficient evidence, and why many Brazilians believe the full truth behind one of the country's darkest criminal cases has never been uncovered.

episodes.title: When Faith Becomes Control.. Inside Malaysia's Most Controversial Cults
episodes.description:
The viral Malaysian drama Bidaah sparked widespread debate for its disturbing portrayal of religious manipulation, but many viewers don't realize that its themes closely resemble real events. In this episode, we explore the true stories behind Malaysia's most controversial deviant sects, including Ayah Pin's Heavenly Kingdom, Al-Arqam, and the recent GISB scandal that shocked the country.


From cult leaders claiming divine powers to allegations of child abuse, forced obedience, and psychological manipulation, this episode examines how extremist groups often disguise themselves behind legitimate religious practices before slowly gaining complete control over their followers. We also explore why Bidaah has become one of Malaysia's most talked-about television series, and the important warning it offers about recognizing manipulation hiding behind faith.

episodes.title: Inside Uganda's Deadliest Cult.. The Movement for the Restoration of the Ten Commandments
episodes.description:
In March 2000, hundreds of members of Uganda's Movement for the Restoration of the Ten Commandments of God gathered inside a church, believing they were about to witness the end of the world. Moments later, the building erupted in flames, killing everyone inside. At first, authorities believed it was a tragic mass suicide.


But the investigation soon uncovered a far more disturbing truth. Mass graves began appearing across Uganda, revealing that many cult members had been murdered long before the fire. In this episode of You Can't Unhear, we explore the rise of Joseph Kibwetere and Credonia Mwerinde, the manipulation that drew thousands into the movement, and the chilling mystery surrounding one of the deadliest cult disasters in modern history.

episodes.title: Inside the Children of Thunder Cult.. Faith, Manipulation, and Murder
episodes.description:
In 2000, Taylor Helzer, a former Mormon missionary who claimed to be a prophet chosen by God, created a small cult known as the Children of Thunder. Alongside his brother Justin and devoted follower Dawn Godman, he manipulated his followers with religious extremism, psychological conditioning, and promises of a divine mission before leading them into a series of brutal murders across California.


In this episode of You Can't Unhear, we examine the rise of Taylor Helzer, the influence of the Children of Thunder cult, the manipulation that transformed ordinary people into accomplices, and the shocking crimes that ultimately brought the group to an end.

episodes.title: Australia's Most Dangerous Cult.. THE FAMILY of Anne Hamilton-Byrne
episodes.description:
For nearly three decades, Anne Hamilton-Byrne built one of Australia's most secretive and disturbing cults. Claiming to be the female reincarnation of Jesus Christ, she convinced doctors, lawyers, nurses, and other respected professionals to help her recruit followers, acquire children through fraudulent adoptions, and create what she believed would become a new master race after the apocalypse.


In this episode of You Can't Unhear, we uncover the shocking story of The Family, the children raised in complete isolation, the psychological abuse hidden behind identical blonde hair and matching clothes, the police raid that finally exposed the cult, and why many survivors believe true justice was never served.

episodes.title: Peru's Darkest Time.. The Cult That Declared War - THE SHINING PATH
episodes.description:
For over a decade, Peru was caught between two brutal forces. The Shining Path, led by former philosophy professor Abimael Guzmán, promised revolution through violence, targeting anyone they believed stood in the way of their vision. Villages were terrorized, public executions became common, and thousands of innocent people were trapped in a conflict they never chose.


In this episode of You Can't Unhear, we explore the rise of the Shining Path, the ideology that fueled one of Latin America's deadliest insurgencies, the massacres that devastated rural Peru, the courage of those who resisted, and how an entire nation was left scarred by fear, extremism, and violence.
